summary: Iter 234 — Tested 'Pancarte VIP aéroport' (Airport VIP Sign) feature end-to-end. Backend exposes passenger_name correctly to the driver and the React component AirportVipSign renders with all data-testids, supports edit mode, and closes cleanly. 4/4 backend tests pass, 100% of UI assertions pass.

issues: On a portrait phone the panel is CSS-rotated 90deg. With long passenger names (e.g. 'TEST_VIP Mr Smith') the heading wraps onto 3 lines because clamp(2.5rem, 11vw, 6rem) sizes by the unrotated viewport width. Cosmetic only — on a real device held landscape the layout is clean. Consider sizing by min(vw,vh) or shrinking when name length > 12 chars.

critical_code_review_comments: AirportVipSign.jsx is clean (~155 lines), has all required data-testids, properly handles edit/display toggle, and gracefully falls back to 'Client' when passenger_name is missing.

Backend enrich_passenger_info correctly prioritizes book_for_name over the user's own name (passenger booking for someone else). passenger_phone, passenger_avatar and passenger_rating are also exposed — good for the sign and the call/SMS flow.
GET /api/rides/{id} correctly strips start_otp/otp from the driver view while still attaching passenger info. Authorization (is_passenger / is_assigned_driver / is_admin) is sound.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all UI assertions: button visibility, modal open, name/greeting/subtitle data-testids, edit mode toggle, close)

test_credentials: Driver phone +33644112233 / Chauffeur2026! (used via /api/auth/phone-login). Client accounts auto-created with TEST_VIP prefix and cleaned up after run.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 airport rides via API (AF1234 from CDG, BA77 with book_for_name='TEST_VIP Mr Smith'), accepted by phone-login driver. Both rides cancelled and test users deleted at teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_airport_vip_passenger_name.py can be reused. It uses phone-login (NOT email login — the driver email 33644112233@sbdrive.local is rejected by pydantic email validator because '.local' is a reserved TLD). For UI: login at /chauffeur/login, country code defaults to +33, fill 644112233 (no prefix) → submit → password → submit, lands on /chauffeur/home which auto-mounts DriverRideFlow when an active airport ride exists. data-testids verified: driver-airport-info, open-vip-sign-btn, airport-vip-sign, vip-sign-name, vip-sign-greeting, vip-sign-subtitle, vip-sign-edit-toggle, vip-sign-name-input, vip-sign-greeting-input, vip-sign-subtitle-input, vip-sign-rotate, vip-sign-close.
rca of the issue: No bug found. Feature works as designed.
